verdict.rationale: Apify documents exporting datasets to open formats (CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML) and pulling items programmatically via the API clients with pagination or into Pandas. Its public OpenAPI spec and CLI support scripted bulk retrieval. However, the evidence only covers dataset results, not a complete export of everything a user holds on the platform. missing for 10: documented full-account or bulk export (key-value stores, Actor source/configs, tasks, schedules, run history), a documented exit/migration path off the platform, independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
